integrity_notes: First public date comes from the initial arXiv posting of the motivating construction, not its 2026 journal release; related earlier results are credited explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Complete result concerns only Bonzio–St. John two-point-fiber McCarthy algebras, not arbitrary Boolean-fiber expansions.
Product formula requires finite index semilattice; the all-cardinality description allows the optional top collapse only if the quotient has a greatest class.
The finite checker is corroboration; the arbitrary-cardinality proof is deductive.
Historical priority remains uncertain, especially as to abstract conditional-algebra congruence representation theorems.
title: Congruences of two-point-fiber McCarthy algebras are controlled by a single top-class choice
